title: Policy-contextual triage and evidence bundler for enterprise security asks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver an intake pipeline that classifies incoming security and compliance requests (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR, DPAs, vendor questionnaires) using request context and customer policy mapping. The system should compute a prioritized SLA estimate, assemble a prefilled evidence bundle (from existing docs and artifact templates), and route the request to the appropriate track (self-serve, concierge, legal review, engineering remediation). This ticket covers the product definition, acceptance criteria, stakeholder alignment, and the initial rollout plan for v1. Goals: reduce time-to-first-response for high-impact asks by 40%, decrease manual evidence collection time by 60%, and provide deterministic routing signals for support and security teams.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming requests are auto-classified into at least four categories: Info-only, Documentation request, Security control clarification, Remediation request
SLA estimator returns one of: Fast (24h), Standard (3-5d), Extended (10-21d) with rationale explanation attached
Evidence bundler generates a zipped artifact containing prefilled templates and links to authoritative docs for at least SOC2 and GDPR requests
Routing rules map >=90% of requests to the correct primary owner (Support, Security, Legal, Engineering) in a pilot dataset
Dashboard shows triage throughput, average time-to-route, and error rate; alerts trigger if misclassifications exceed 8% over a 2-week window
Privacy and PII handling approved by Security; no sensitive customer data is stored in plain text by the bundler

risks: If control-to-doc mappings are incomplete, evidence bundler will return low-quality artifacts and increase manual work
Storing or transmitting customer-supplied spreadsheets could surface PII; must enforce redaction and encryption policies
Premature ML classifier rollout could route sensitive asks incorrectly — mitigated by rule-first approach for v1
next_steps: Legal/Compliance to publish canonical control mapping CSV and ownership by 2026-03-22
ENG to deliver rule-engine prototype and deploy to staging with 300 historical requests by 2026-03-26
Design to finalize agent UI for override/notes and evidence review by 2026-03-20
Create pilot cohort (10 customers) for beta validation and feedback during 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-13
notes: Opted for a conservative rollout: rule engine + evidence templates in v1 to meet enterprise audit timelines. Plan to add ML-based scorer in v2 once mappings and labels are >95% consistent. Track metrics weekly and expose a single triage-accuracy KPI in Console.
estimate_rationale: 8 points: includes product spec, design of templates, rule-engine implementation, 1-week integration with Support queue, and basic dashboarding for metrics
